insights: Nagaland has the largest share of baseline lower-coverage districts: 100.0% (11 of 11).
The largest baseline cluster gap is Mothers who had at least 4 antenatal care visits: 34.9 percentage points.
The retained baseline contains 236 higher-coverage and 105 lower-coverage districts.
